title: the Marlowe Estate Rising Revisited
author: Jonah Montrose
blurb: Theo Halloran, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
